turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on numbers and time words?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Remember: half past means 30 minutes after the hour, quarter past means 15 minutes after, and quarter to means 15 minutes before. When a time changes, the last time is the final one.

Read this dialogue.
A: Is the lesson at nine?
B: No, it starts at ten.
A: OK, thanks.

What time is the lesson?
